title: Beef Au Jus
description: Tender beef cooked in a rich, flavorful au jus sauce, served with roasted vegetables.
instructions: Season the beef with salt and pepper.
Sear the beef in a hot pan until browned on all sides.
Transfer the beef to a pot and add the red wine, beef broth, tomato paste, and herbs.
Bring the mixture to a boil, then cover and transfer to the preheated oven.
Roast the beef for 2-3 hours, or until tender.
Meanwhile, toss the carrots and celery in a bowl with olive oil and season with salt and pepper.
Spread the vegetables on a baking sheet and roast in the oven for 20-25 minutes, or until tender.
Slice the beef against the grain and serve with the roasted vegetables and au jus sauce.
Strain the au jus sauce through a fine-mesh sieve into a clean pot and bring to a simmer.
Skim off any excess fat and season with salt and pepper to taste.
Serve the au jus sauce over the beef and vegetables.
